meta.excluded: override specials (Godmode/Plague/seeds/Lith0), Plague chroma, bundles, wash, self-trades
meta.caveat: mode is current snapshot, not mode-as-of-sale (firstDaydreamTs pending)
meta.alpha_selection: single fit, side as a feature

ask_premium.note: ask = bid x this. One fit, is-ask indicator; guarantees ask >= bid for every parcel.

floor_calibration.note: index_floor / live_floor on the most recent overlapping day. Multiply the live floor by this before applying fitted multiples, which were trained against the index. Re-measured every 24h by ops/daily-refit.sh — a value older than that is stale and will overprice when the listing floor moves away from transacted prices.
